analyst.summary: Supriya Lifescience is a debt-free, high-return API exporter that had a bumpy first half of FY26 (a production-facility repair outage) but closed the year strongly as new capacity ramped, finishing FY26 with 18.9% revenue growth and management guiding another ~20% for FY27. Its key US regulatory inspection in February 2026 closed cleanly with only one minor observation and a favorable compliance classification, removing a major pharma-specific risk. The stock trades at a full ~32x earnings multiple for that growth, so we rate it a Hold -- a genuinely well-run, clean-balance-sheet business, but priced for continued flawless execution rather than offering a discount.
